challenges.name: grade-book
challenges.title: Build the GradeBook: add, score, drop, report
challenges.description: Implement the four member functions of the Riverside Polytechnic grade book. The class keeps a private std::map from student id to Student{name, scores}. add_student registers a student and refuses a duplicate id; add_score records a score and refuses an unknown id without ever creating a student; drop removes a student and all their scores and refuses an unknown id; report() const returns "students: N" followed by one line per student in id order with the number of scores, the average rounded once to 2 decimals and the letter grade for that rounded value on the 10-point scale (>= 8.5 A, >= 8.0 B+, >= 7.0 B, >= 6.5 C+, >= 5.5 C, >= 5.0 D+, >= 4.0 D, otherwise F). A student with no scores shows "avg -" and "-". The test runner reads command lines (add, score, drop, report), calls your functions and prints the error lines; the starter specifies every output line exactly.
